notes: Replication target is pre-registered sample, not exploratory entire sample of 115. Main text prints p >.59, whereas Figure 3 caption prints p<.59. Main text also prints 59% for 18/32 while the discussion prints 56%; no conversion made. No numerical binomial test statistic or standardized effect size is printed for the target test. Original title and DOI verified in author-hosted published PDF web extraction. Its target results are fully captured, although the cached web response ends later in Experiment 2. Original pooled binomial test is recorded because the neutral locator does not identify an age subgroup; target_match remains null. Separately printed subgroup results are 12 of 16 nine-month-olds, one-tailed p < .05, and 13 of 18 five-month-olds, one-tailed p < .05. These subgroup tests were not merged with the pooled test. Supplied original p. 5 differs from published pagination. Replication cache has no page boundaries; p. 26 is the supplied locator, with section and exact passage used to identify the test. Reported success is the author verdict for the pre-registered sample; the author separately describes the exploratory entire sample as replicating.
